headlines.snippet: Syria has condemned the attack on Saudi Arabia's King Fahd International Airport. The statement was issued by the Syrian Arab News Agency (SANA).

headlines.title: Gaza death toll from Israeli war rises to 74,498, with more than 175,000 injured - سانا
headlines.snippet: The death toll from the Israeli war in Gaza has risen to 74,498, with over 175,000 injured, according to SANA. These figures highlight the extensive casualties.

headlines.title: Syria condemns Israeli occupation killing of disabled young man in western Daraa - سانا
headlines.snippet: Syria condemned the killing of a disabled young man by the Israeli occupation forces in western Daraa. The statement was released by SANA.

headlines.title: Syrian, Jordanian foreign ministers discuss bilateral ties, regional developments - سانا
headlines.snippet: Syrian and Jordanian foreign ministers discussed bilateral ties and regional developments. The meeting aimed to strengthen cooperation between the two countries.

headlines.title: Security operation targets cell affiliated with ISIS terrorist group - سانا
headlines.snippet: A security operation targeted a cell affiliated with the ISIS terrorist group. This action is part of ongoing efforts to combat terrorism.

headlines.title: Syria’s Kurds fight to keep their language alive in the classroom
headlines.snippet: Syrian Kurds are striving to preserve their language in classrooms amidst protests against Arabic-language instruction in northeastern schools. They fear educational setbacks and the erosion of Kurdish identity.

headlines.title: What Syria’s revolution can teach the world about democracy
headlines.snippet: Journalist and author Anand Gopal reflects on Syria's unfinished revolution, its democratic experiments, and the challenges facing the country's leadership in an interview with Syria Direct.

headlines.title: The Damascus oud maker fighting to keep a generations-old craft alive
headlines.snippet: Damascus oud maker Antoun “Tony” al-Tawil is working to keep a generations-old craft alive, weathering war, displacement, and economic crisis with community support.

headlines.title: A terrible beauty is born: Syria after Assad
headlines.snippet: Robin Yassin-Kassab examines post-Assad Syria, highlighting the possibilities of revolution alongside violence, communal tensions, and external threats confronting the country's fragile political transition.

headlines.title: Syria’s Muslim Brotherhood fights for its future
headlines.snippet: Syria's Muslim Brotherhood is weighing its political future under regional pressure and internal divisions, as the country's uncertain transition raises questions about political parties and pluralism.

headlines.title: Dammam’s King Fahd airport resumes operations after attack kills 2
headlines.snippet: Dammam's King Fahd Airport has resumed operations following an attack that resulted in two deaths. The airport is now functioning normally after the incident.

headlines.title: Trump says Iran is trying to drive up oil prices before the midterm elections
headlines.snippet: Trump asserts that Iran is attempting to manipulate oil prices before the midterm elections. This statement links Iranian actions to US political events.

headlines.title: UN chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, warns an ‘El Nino of war’ is hitting world’s poor
headlines.snippet: The UN chief has condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and warned of an 'El Nino of war' impacting the world's poor. This highlights the global consequences of the conflict.

headlines.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader Khamenei meets parliament speaker Qalibaf, state broadcaster IRIB reports
headlines.snippet: Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei met with Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf, according to state broadcaster IRIB. This meeting signifies high-level political discussions.

headlines.title: A second female lawmaker in Australia is threatened days after alleged car attack
headlines.snippet: A second female lawmaker in Australia has received threats days after an alleged car attack. This follows a previous incident involving a lawmaker.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport resumes operations after deadly attack kills two, injures eight
headlines.snippet: Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport has resumed operations after a deadly attack killed two people and injured eight. Normal operations have been restored following the incident.

headlines.title: What UAE residents need to know today, October 22: King Fahd airport attack, Hormuz tensions and travel disruptions
headlines.snippet: Residents in the UAE are being informed about the King Fahd airport attack, tensions in Hormuz, and travel disruptions. This provides a daily update on key regional events.

headlines.title: US orders embassy staff to leave Saudi Arabia as deadly attacks escalate
headlines.snippet: The US has ordered embassy staff to leave Saudi Arabia as deadly attacks escalate. This decision reflects growing security concerns in the region.

headlines.title: Saudi Aramco evacuates Dhahran headquarters, orders staff to work from home
headlines.snippet: Saudi Aramco has evacuated its Dhahran headquarters and instructed staff to work from home. This measure is a precautionary response to security threats.

headlines.title: US, Israel draw up plans for 72-hour Iran strike: 7 key questions on Trump’s strategy and Tehran’s response
headlines.snippet: Reports indicate that the US and Israel have drawn up plans for a 72-hour strike on Iran. The report details key questions regarding Trump's strategy and Tehran's response.

headlines.title: Israeli premier orders ‘closure’ of Hebron, ‘full lockdown’ of occupied West Bank
headlines.snippet: Prime Minister Netanyahu has ordered the closure of Hebron and a full lockdown of the occupied West Bank. This measure follows recent security incidents in the area.

headlines.title: 1 Palestinian killed, others injured in fresh Israeli attack on Gaza
headlines.snippet: One Palestinian was killed and others injured in a new Israeli attack on Gaza. An Israeli drone targeted a bicycle in southern Gaza, according to local sources.

headlines.title: 1 killed, 4 injured after gunman opens fire in northern France
headlines.snippet: One person was killed and four were injured after a gunman opened fire in northern France. The suspect has been arrested and taken into police custody.

headlines.title: Thousands without power as UK prepares for Storm Boelo
headlines.snippet: Thousands are without power in the UK as the country prepares for Storm Boelo. Forecasters warn of danger to life from the storm's strong winds, large waves, and debris.

headlines.title: Kremlin says ‘1st tanker’ carrying Russian diesel fuel as part of deal with US has departed
headlines.snippet: The Kremlin announced that the first tanker carrying Russian diesel fuel, as part of a deal with the US, has departed. Spokesman Peskov stated these shipments will continue regularly.

headlines.title: Geopolitical knot in EastMed: Intelligence diplomacy on Türkiye-Libya axis
headlines.snippet: Geopolitical intelligence diplomacy is focusing on the Türkiye-Libya axis in the East Mediterranean. Despite past setbacks, relations have progressed significantly.

headlines.title: 2 dead, 5 injured in coal mine explosion in Türkiye
headlines.snippet: Two people were killed and five others injured in a firedamp explosion at a private coal mine in Zonguldak, northern Türkiye. The explosion occurred at a colliery.

headlines.title: Volvo Cars announces 2,500 job cuts after disastrous Q3
headlines.snippet: Volvo Cars announced 2,500 job cuts after a disastrous third quarter. Shares dropped significantly due to US tariffs and strong competition in China.

headlines.title: Tanker carrying Russian diesel on way to US after Putin-Trump deal
headlines.snippet: A tanker carrying 40,000 metric tons of Russian diesel is en route to New York, following an agreement between Moscow and the US. Ship-tracking data confirmed the departure.

headlines.title: Israeli strikes kill at least 4 Palestinians in Gaza despite cease-fire
headlines.snippet: At least four Palestinians were killed in Gaza by Israeli strikes and gunfire on Thursday. These attacks occurred despite a US-brokered ceasefire.

headlines.snippet: An attack on Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport resulted in two deaths and eight injuries. The incident occurred at King Fahd International Airport.

headlines.snippet: Barghouti stated that Israeli restrictions have transformed the occupied West Bank into 'fragmented prisons.' This describes the impact of ongoing Israeli policies.

headlines.snippet: Türkiye, Qatar, Indonesia, and Pakistan have signed the 'Badr' defense cooperation accord. This agreement aims to enhance collaboration in defense matters.

headlines.snippet: President Erdogan welcomed Libya's approval of a maritime deal with Türkiye. This agreement strengthens bilateral relations and territorial understanding.
